title: A declaration of written code — visual-communication capability
description: Formal shape of a declaration `code/<name>.yaml` in the location (DEC-002 point 1, DEC-005 point 7): the code writer, the version of the spelling it follows, the brand, the lock of the brand and what it builds on, and where the code goes; optionally a prefix of every name it writes, and the losses accepted. Document-shaped schema. Companion per COR-018.

pkit_schema.description: The schema that binds this file (COR-023; DEC-002 point 3): `visual-communication:code`.

schema_version.description: The format number, shared by every schema of the capability (DEC-003 point 1).

form.description: The version of the code writer's spelling: `css` spells form 1, `json` forms 1 and 2.

out.description: Where the code goes: a file of the project, outside `.pkit/` and any hidden folder.

prefix.description: A name that opens every name the code writes. The `json` writer takes none: the capability's code refuses it, naming why.
